summary: Israeli forces began destroying the Ali Taher ridge tunnel complex in southern Lebanon, described as the largest IRGC base outside Iran. Yemeni Ansarullah forces captured the strategic al-Ardhi port on the Bab al-Mandeb strait and liberated the southwestern Yemeni coast. Projectiles struck two vessels near Oman's Musandam peninsula, setting one ablaze.

UKMTO reported multiple projectiles hitting two vessels 4 nautical miles west of Khasab, Oman, causing a fire on one ship. (Source: @VahidOnline/78323)

Artillery shelling intensified on Jabal al-Tahr and Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/390731)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli forces began destroying the Ali Taher ridge tunnel complex in southern Lebanon, described by the Israeli Prime Minister as the largest IRGC base outside Iran. Yemeni Ansarullah forces captured the strategic al-Ardhi port on the Bab al-Mandeb strait and liberated the southwestern Yemeni coast including islands off Al-Khokha. Simultaneously, projectiles struck two vessels near Oman's Musandam peninsula, setting one ablaze, while Saudi-backed mercenaries faced blockades by UAE-aligned forces in Aden and Lahj.

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous destruction of the Ali Taher tunnel complex and Yemeni advances on the Bab al-Mandeb indicate a coordinated Israeli-U.S. pressure campaign against Iranian regional proxies. The naval attacks near Musandam suggest Houthi capability to threaten Gulf shipping lanes despite Israeli strikes in Lebanon. Intra-GCC friction between Saudi and UAE proxies in Yemen creates exploitation opportunities for Ansarullah. Iran's nuclear activity at Makoush mountain, coupled with Trump's explicit threats, raises the probability of kinetic escalation against Iranian nuclear sites before the U.S. election.
sections.regional_response: Russia and China blocked UN snapback sanctions on Iran, preserving Tehran's diplomatic shield. Algeria's rupture with the UAE over Israel ties signals widening Arab fractures. Somaliland's offer of troops for Gaza reflects African Union alignment with U.S. stabilization plans. Omani investigation into the Musandam attacks will test Gulf unity on maritime security. Iranian FM reiterated support for Yemen's sovereignty and demanded an end to the siege, framing Houthi gains as legitimate resistance.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Ali Taher tunnel demolition represents a major degradation of IRGC forward logistics in Lebanon, but Hezbollah's missile arsenal remains largely intact. Houthi control of al-Ardhi port enables potential anti-ship missile deployment overlooking the Bab al-Mandeb. The Musandam attacks demonstrate precision targeting of commercial vessels in confined waters. IAEA detection at Makoush suggests Iran may be advancing weaponization work under cover of civilian nuclear activities. Trump's rhetoric indicates a potential U.S. military option against Iranian nuclear sites if re-elected.
